statement: Ziems is a primary V4 target only when treated as a scoped subset rather than a whole-program replication.
rationale: The official repo and paper give a real audit surface, but the full suite is too broad and heterogeneous for a fair first-wave audit.
keyAssumptions: A narrow subset of public label-based tasks can be selected.
Those tasks still download and execute cleanly.
validationCriteria: Chosen tasks have stable data access and obvious output spaces.
Subset-level audit remains recognizable as a fair engagement with the paper.
critiquePoints: Some tasks may rely on brittle sources or unavailable model endpoints.
Whole-suite reproduction would exceed reasonable first-wave scope.
